<description>
The double spend case in `TestBasicMining` is meant to check that block template creation fails when two mempool transactions spend the same coin. It reuses the transaction from the preceding coinbase case, whose prevout was cleared with `SetNull()`, and only overwrites the prevout hash. The output index therefore stays `COutPoint::NULL_INDEX`, so both transactions spend an output of `txFirst[0]` that does not exist.

Set the output index to 0, so the first transaction is a valid spend and only the second one makes fail.

Found while working on #36692 and https://github.com/yuvicc/bitcoin/pull/19.
</description>
